defects.defect: Foundation and OSS admission incorrectly required Python 3.13 on hardened Ubuntu 24.04 source gates without setup-python.
defects.correction: Keep Windows production runtime at Python 3.13.14 while restoring Linux/source-package compatibility to Python 3.12+.

defects.defect: Atomic finance JSON publication called os.replace while NamedTemporaryFile was still open, causing WinError 32.
defects.correction: Flush and fsync inside the context, close the file, then call os.replace; clean up fail-closed on error.

defects.defect: Finance output durability used os.fsync on a read-only file descriptor, which fails on Windows after the temporary-file handle correction.
defects.correction: Open completed output artifacts with read/write access before os.fsync so Windows FlushFileBuffers receives a write-capable handle.

claim_boundary: M2 may close only after exact-head remote gates; merge, release and physical L5 remain separately blocked
